# Assessment Overview

This folder contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated for this report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): Dependency categorization and compatibility observations.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Persistence model, ownership boundaries, and data classification.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, profiles, properties, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Primary business workflows and decision logic sequence.
